{"people":[{"name":"Sam","role":"account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"Lucy","role":"ecommerce director, champion","side":"customer"},{"name":"Martin","role":"CFO, final decision maker (never met by rep)","side":"customer"},{"name":"Farah","role":"our solutions engineer","side":"us"},{"name":"The controller","role":"customer controller, built one-pager for Martin","side":"customer"},{"name":"IT lead","role":"customer IT lead, nervous about moving before spring","side":"customer"},{"name":"PMM","role":"interviewer","side":"us"}],
"competitors":["Fiserv"],
"incumbent":"Fiserv through their bank",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their ecommerce director, Lucy, came inbound.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Lead was inbound from Lucy."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"She said about one in twelve online orders was failing at the payment step, and it was worse on the big baskets.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Trigger: checkout payment failures, worse on large baskets. Rep relays what customer said."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"Customers would call in annoyed, or just not come back.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Customer impact of failures, relayed by rep."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"she couldn't get a straight answer from the processor on why.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Processor gave no explanation for declines."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"Her number. Off their own dashboard.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"One-in-twelve figure came from customer dashboard."},
{"id":"E6","turn":6,"excerpt":"The CFO, Martin. Lucy was the champion, she wanted it, IT was fine with it. Martin said no.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Martin decided; Lucy champion; IT fine."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"Lucy told me. I never met him.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Decider known only secondhand; no direct contact."},
{"id":"E8","turn":8,"excerpt":"Lucy said he doesn't take vendor meetings and she'd carry it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Access to Martin was blocked; Lucy carried the case."},
{"id":"E9","turn":10,"excerpt":"They were on Fiserv through their bank, had been forever.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Incumbent is Fiserv via bank."},
{"id":"E10","turn":10,"excerpt":"when the bank heard, they came back and sharpened the rate.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Incumbent responded with a better rate, per Lucy."},
{"id":"E11","turn":10,"excerpt":"No new product, nothing. Just a better rate.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep relays competitor offered only price; sourced to Lucy."},
{"id":"E12","turn":12,"excerpt":"Up to then Lucy was asking about declines.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Early questions were about declines."},
{"id":"E13","turn":12,"excerpt":"After the bank came back, every email was the rate.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","competitor"],"note":"Question focus shifted to rate after bank's counter."},
{"id":"E14","turn":14,"excerpt":"Lucy loved the checkout. And the decline piece.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep's read of reaction; supported by nodding observation."},
{"id":"E15","turn":14,"excerpt":"Lucy was nodding the whole way.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Observed reaction to Farah's decline explanation."},
{"id":"E16","turn":14,"excerpt":"Silence, honestly, nothing bombed. It was a good cycle. We lost on price.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","outcome"],"note":"Rep's verdict: no silence, lost on price."},
{"id":"E17","turn":16,"excerpt":"When Lucy came out of her meeting with Martin.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Moment rep felt it was lost."},
{"id":"E18","turn":16,"excerpt":"he's not going to pay more for the same thing.","label":"quote","speaker":"Lucy","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","language"],"note":"Lucy relaying Martin's reaction by phone."},
{"id":"E19","turn":16,"excerpt":"Right before that she'd been telling me it was a formality.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Lucy expected approval; reversal was sudden."},
{"id":"E20","turn":18,"excerpt":"The controller did a one-pager for Martin. Our rate, their rate, side by side.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","gaps"],"note":"Comparison page built by customer controller."},
{"id":"E21","turn":20,"excerpt":"The per-transaction number.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","gaps"],"note":"Only per-transaction rate compared."},
{"id":"E22","turn":20,"excerpt":"Which isn't fair, because they pay a gateway fee on top, and they've got a person who does nothing but chargebacks.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep's view that comparison omitted gateway fee and chargeback labor."},
{"id":"E23","turn":22,"excerpt":"Our quote.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Only item from us on the page was the quote."},
{"id":"E24","turn":24,"excerpt":"I wasn't in the room. Lucy presented it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Rep absent; Lucy presented to Martin and controller."},
{"id":"E25","turn":24,"excerpt":"Why would I pay more for the same thing.","label":"quote","speaker":"Martin","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","language"],"note":"Martin's words secondhand via Lucy; differs slightly from T16."},
{"id":"E26","turn":26,"excerpt":"Which it isn't. But that's what he said.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","gaps"],"note":"Rep disagrees that offerings are the same."},
{"id":"E27","turn":28,"excerpt":"We showed the uplift slide. The average improvement in acceptance.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","message"],"note":"Value shown was generic average, not customer-specific."},
{"id":"E28","turn":28,"excerpt":"Lucy got it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep's belief that Lucy understood uplift."},
{"id":"E29","turn":30,"excerpt":"Not in a doc, no.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"No Fernbrook-specific value figure was documented."},
{"id":"E30","turn":30,"excerpt":"Farah offered to run their declines. She wanted a three-month export so she could show what the failed orders were worth.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Value analysis offered but not done."},
{"id":"E31","turn":30,"excerpt":"it was the last two weeks of the quarter, and I didn't want to slow things down.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep chose not to pursue export due to quarter-end timing."},
{"id":"E32","turn":30,"excerpt":"Lucy was sold. I didn't think we needed it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep's judgment that value figure was unnecessary."},
{"id":"E33","turn":32,"excerpt":"...Nothing from us. I assume Lucy told him.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decider"],"note":"No cost-of-failure material reached Martin; assumption Lucy conveyed it."},
{"id":"E34","turn":34,"excerpt":"Yes. Probably.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Guess that price match would have won."},
{"id":"E35","turn":34,"excerpt":"their IT lead was a bit nervous about moving before spring, that's their whole year.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Timing/risk concern from IT lead, reported to rep."},
{"id":"E36","turn":34,"excerpt":"He'd said he'd do it if finance approved.","label":"fact","speaker":"IT lead","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"IT conditional on finance approval."},
{"id":"E37","turn":34,"excerpt":"So maybe not only the rate. But the rate is what killed it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","gaps"],"note":"Rep hedges, then reasserts rate as the cause."},
{"id":"E38","turn":36,"excerpt":"Lucy asked once if we had something she could hand Martin. Like a one-page business case.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer asked for a business case asset."},
{"id":"E39","turn":36,"excerpt":"I sent her the deck and the pricing proposal.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"No business case provided."},
{"id":"E40","turn":38,"excerpt":"The customer stories. The average uplift.","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Deck had only generic proof, no business case."},
{"id":"E41","turn":40,"excerpt":"orders dying at the last step.","label":"quote","speaker":"Lucy","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Lucy's phrase for the problem."},
{"id":"E42","turn":40,"excerpt":"the big baskets.","label":"quote","speaker":"Lucy","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Lucy's phrase for high-value orders."},
{"id":"E43","turn":40,"excerpt":"we do all the work to get someone to buy a four-thousand-dollar greenhouse and then the card says no.","label":"quote","speaker":"Lucy","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","trigger"],"note":"Vivid customer articulation of the problem."},
{"id":"E44","turn":40,"excerpt":"From Martin, secondhand, all I have is \"the same thing.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","language"],"note":"Rep admits Martin's words are secondhand and minimal."},
{"id":"E45","turn":42,"excerpt":"If we'd had more room on the rate, we win this.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Sam","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Rep's counterfactual; price-focused lesson."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E16","E34","E37"],"what":"Rep says lost on price and rate killed it, but later concedes IT nervousness and Martin's page showing same rate, so maybe not only rate."},
{"evidence":["E16","E19","E24"],"what":"Rep says it was a good cycle, yet Lucy expected a formality and then Martin rejected it in a meeting the rep never attended."},
{"evidence":["E14","E38","E40"],"what":"Rep says nothing got silence and Lucy was sold, yet Lucy asked for a business case and none existed beyond generic stories."},
{"evidence":["E32","E33"],"what":"Rep said Lucy was sold and a figure was unnecessary, then admitted Martin received nothing from us on cost of failures and only assumed Lucy told him."},
{"evidence":["E18","E25"],"what":"Martin's reported words differ between the two tellings: 'not going to pay more for the same thing' versus 'Why would I pay more for the same thing.'"},
{"evidence":["E26","E27","E45"],"what":"Rep says the offerings are not the same thing, yet the team never put a customer-specific value figure in front of Martin, and the lesson is more rate room."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?","turn":14,"what":"Answered 'Silence, honestly, nothing bombed' and moved to the price loss; named no part that got silence."},
{"question":"Did we put a figure on the value they'd get?","turn":28,"what":"Answered with the generic uplift slide and 'Lucy got it' before admitting no Fernbrook figure."},
{"question":"What did Martin have in front of him about what one in twelve orders was costing?","turn":32,"what":"Answered 'Nothing from us' with an assumption that Lucy told him."},
{"question":"If we had matched the price, would we have won?","turn":34,"what":"Said 'Yes. Probably' then listed other obstacles and hedged with 'maybe not only the rate'."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"orders dying at the last step","ours":"declines / failed orders / acceptance","evidence":["E41","E12","E28"]},
{"theirs":"the big baskets","ours":"big-ticket orders","evidence":["E42"]},
{"theirs":"the same thing","ours":"our solution as different (decline fix, uplift)","evidence":["E25","E26"]},
{"theirs":"rate / per-transaction number","ours":"uplift in acceptance / value","evidence":["E13","E21","E27"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E6","E16"],"what":"Deal lost: Martin (CFO) said no after seeing the rate comparison."},
{"evidence":["E10","E13"],"what":"Incumbent Fiserv/bank sharpened its rate, and the customer stayed with them."},
{"evidence":["E36","E35"],"what":"IT lead would proceed if finance approved but was nervous about timing before spring."},
{"evidence":["E34","E37"],"what":"Rep believes matching the price probably wins, but admits other factors may have mattered."}
]}

contradictions.what: Rep says lost on price and rate killed it, but later concedes IT nervousness and Martin's page showing same rate, so maybe not only rate.
Rep says it was a good cycle, yet Lucy expected a formality and then Martin rejected it in a meeting the rep never attended.
Rep says nothing got silence and Lucy was sold, yet Lucy asked for a business case and none existed beyond generic stories.
Rep said Lucy was sold and a figure was unnecessary, then admitted Martin received nothing from us on cost of failures and only assumed Lucy told him.
Martin's reported words differ between the two tellings: 'not going to pay more for the same thing' versus 'Why would I pay more for the same thing.'
Rep says the offerings are not the same thing, yet the team never put a customer-specific value figure in front of Martin, and the lesson is more rate room.

dodges.question: If we had matched the price, would we have won?
dodges.what: Said 'Yes. Probably' then listed other obstacles and hedged with 'maybe not only the rate'.

outcome_signals.what: Deal lost: Martin (CFO) said no after seeing the rate comparison.
Incumbent Fiserv/bank sharpened its rate, and the customer stayed with them.
IT lead would proceed if finance approved but was nervous about timing before spring.
Rep believes matching the price probably wins, but admits other factors may have mattered.
